name: HealthBench Hard
intro: HealthBench Hard 是从 HealthBench 5,000 个对话中按多模型低分筛出的 1,000 个困难样本。构建时先剔除没有任何模型获得正分（即所有模型分数均不大于 0）的约 1.5% 样本，再按五家模型提供方的平均 HealthBench 分数选择最低 1,000 个；原始对话、医生 rubric 和正式评分公式均保持不变。
build_method: HealthBench子集筛选, 多提供方模型难度排序
metric: 医生编写Rubric的模型评分, 截断均值, Bootstrap标准误
task_type: 开放式医疗对话, 医疗安全
eval_feature: 多模型难例选择, 医生Rubric, 模型裁判
scale: 1,000 个困难对话（从 HealthBench 5,000 个对话筛选）
build_method_en: HealthBench Subset Selection, Cross-provider Model Difficulty Ranking
eval_feature_en: Multi-model Hard-case Selection, Physician Rubrics, Model-based Grader
intro_en: HealthBench Hard is a 1,000-example difficult subset selected from HealthBench's 5,000 conversations. Construction first removes the roughly 1.5% of examples on which no selection model earns a positive score (all model scores are at most 0), then takes the 1,000 lowest average HealthBench scores across five model providers. The original conversations, physician rubrics, and official scoring formula remain unchanged.
scale_en: 1,000 difficult conversations selected from 5,000 HealthBench conversations
metric_en: Model-graded Physician Rubric Score, Clipped Mean, Bootstrap Standard Error

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2505.08775v1 Appendix C, the official HealthBench dataset pin 40ee1968, the 1,000-row hard_2025-05-08-21-00-10.jsonl release with SHA-256 b0320430e5cd974e746585594c1dd10b5a3fc2aff9c72b26106c2c4a069d74e9, and openai/simple-evals pin 652c89d0. Appendix C scores all 5,000 conversations with o3, Grok 3, Gemini 2.5 Pro March 2025, Claude 3.7 extended thinking, and Llama 4 Maverick; removes the roughly 1.5% for which no model earns a positive score; averages across providers; and selects the lowest 1,000. The inherited signed-criterion score is the sum of met signed points divided by the positive-point maximum, followed by a clipped aggregate mean. Artifact boundary: the selection score matrix is not present in public rows, a small private IID held-out set is retained, and optional GPT-5.4/length flags in the pinned runner are later additions rather than the paper protocol.
